bias.en: Rebound · MACD crossed up, under the SAR and 200-day
bias.zh: 反弹 · MACD 上穿，仍低于抛物线 SAR 和 200 日均线

read.en: Bloom Energy fell 3.6% on Nov 12 to $201.93, trading $193.44–208.90. It is above the 5-day ($192.8) and 10-day ($194.5) and below the 30-day ($228.5), 100-day ($237.2) and 200-day ($223.4); only the 200-day is rising. MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 12, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 ($217.85), and RSI is 46.0.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 11月12日下跌 3.6%，收于 $201.93，盘中区间 $193.44–208.90。股价位于 5 日（$192.8）和 10 日均线（$194.5）上方，30 日（$228.5）、100 日（$237.2）和 200 日均线（$223.4）下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 于 11月12日上穿信号线，在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看空（$217.85），RSI 为 46.0。

read.en: The pullback gave back part of Nov 11's gain, but the dip to $193.44 held the 10-day and the close stayed above the $194.5–199.8 support. Resistance is $208.9–209.5 (Nov 12 high, Nov 11 close), then $217.9–220.5 (SAR, Nov 11 and Nov 3 highs) and $223.4 (200-day). Support is $193.4–199.8, then $185.4–189 and $168.8. A close above $209.5 would target $218–220.5; below $193.4, $185–189.

r.en: Parabolic SAR and Nov 11 high $217.85; Nov 3 high $220.5
r.zh: 抛物线 SAR 及11月11日高点 $217.85；11月3日高点 $220.5
